card.name: C. difficile warning wording
card.fires_on: The word "against" and the "C" and "." of "C. difficile" in the standard C. difficile-associated diarrhea (CDAD) warning, especially in "not directed against C. difficile".

modes.label: "against" before C. difficile
modes.description: The word "against" in "antibacterial drugs not directed against C. difficile".
modes.example: ongoing use of antibacterial drugs not directed<< against>> C. difficile may need to be discontinued

modes.description: The "C" or the period of "C. difficile" in the CDAD warning.
